description: Deliver (F219, the approved script's Stage 5): each time a milestone is ready it becomes a build you can play and share — the welcome (first time only) → the Release Check for its stage (Playable, Alpha, Beta, 1.0; not ready: finish it first or move it to the next stage) → Polish & Stand-ins → Safety & Legal → Build & Share (nothing merges, versions, pushes or goes live without your own "Share it"; an auto run stops there) → Playtest Notes into the roadmap → back to Develop at Plan the Sprint
